dos.text: Rely on the automatic focus-restore behavior instead of tracking focus yourself, it already walks back through shadow roots to find and restore whatever had focus before the panel opened.
Set neverhidden if content inside genuinely needs to stay laid out and measurable while the panel is closed.

donts.text: Don't treat hidden as a plain style toggle, its own setter lazily initializes the shadow DOM content the first time the panel is shown, so toggling it does real setup work.
Don't hand-roll side or position math for an arrow panel, connectedCallback already defaults it for you unless you explicitly set your own values first.
